title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：temperature　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 temperature 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the researcher ① took the temperature that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the taking was the whole of the term. The ② temperature, meaning the reading itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a temperature, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ temperature in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ temperature at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A temperature, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the temperature was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the reading. The ⑥ temperature, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; temperature, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a reading and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ temperature had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ temperature of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of describing; temperature, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ temperature I remember is the reading described in the paper, which closed in 1991 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ temperature, my mother said in 1993, is the only reading that improves by being described; every temperature, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a reading. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 温度（指实验室里每一度旁边的那一度）
B. n. 温度（指那度温度本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the temperature 量这一度温度
D. n. 温度（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 温度之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的温度之事）
F. n. 温度（指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一度）
G. n. 温度、冷暖（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 冷暖（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the temperature that no student in the lab would have described
The temperature, meaning the reading itself and not the tube
the temperature at the far bench
the temperature was the whole of the matter
the temperature had become a line in a paper
The temperature of the whole thing
A temperature, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: take the temperature 意为“量这一度温度”，1984 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一度温度做了一遍。
temperature 意为“温度”，指那度温度本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
temperature 意为“温度”，指实验室里每一度旁边的那一度，每一度旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
temperature 意为“温度”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
temperature 意为“温度、冷暖”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这度冷暖就是那件事的全部。
temperature 意为“冷暖”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那度温度，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
temperature 意为“温度”，指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一度，到 1989 年这一度成了研究报告里的一行。
temperature 意为“温度之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的温度之事是一处实验室和三个学期的描述。
temperature 意为“温度”，我记得的是研究报告里描述过的那一度，1991 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一度。
temperature 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，温度是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的温度。
